aria-describedby.zh-CN: 对话框的 aria-describedby，缺省在同时有标题和内容时指向内容。
aria-describedby.en-US: aria-describedby of the dialog. Defaults to the content when there are both a title and content.

aria-label.zh-CN: 对话框的 aria-label，传入后优先于标题。
aria-label.en-US: aria-label of the dialog. When given, it takes precedence over the title.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 对话框的 aria-labelledby，缺省指向标题，没有标题时指向内容。
aria-labelledby.en-US: aria-labelledby of the dialog. Defaults to the title, or to the content without a title.

afterClose.zh-CN: 确认框关闭且离场动画结束后调用。
afterClose.en-US: Called after the card has closed and its leave animation has finished.

afterOpen.zh-CN: 确认框打开且进场动画结束后调用；没有进场动画时打开后即调用，受控与非受控相同；进场结束前被关闭的打开不调用。
afterOpen.en-US: Called after the card has opened and its enter animation has finished, or right after opening when there is no enter animation, controlled or not; not called for an open that is closed before the enter animation ends.

arrowPointAtCenter.zh-CN: 箭头是否指向触发元素中心，需要同时开启 showArrow。
arrowPointAtCenter.en-US: Whether the arrow points at the center of the trigger. Requires showArrow.

arrowStyle.zh-CN: 箭头的边框色、背景色与边框透明度。
arrowStyle.en-US: borderColor, backgroundColor and borderOpacity of the arrow.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 弹出层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the popup flips automatically when it would be clipped.

cancelButtonProps.zh-CN: 取消按钮的属性，autoFocus 为 true 时打开后聚焦该按钮，onclick 先于内置的取消处理执行。
cancelButtonProps.en-US: Props of the cancel button. autoFocus focuses it on open; onclick runs before the built-in cancel handling.

cancelText.zh-CN: 取消按钮文字，缺省取语言包 Popconfirm.cancel。
cancelText.en-US: Cancel button text. Defaults to the locale entry Popconfirm.cancel.

child.zh-CN: 直接渲染触发元素的 snippet，参数 `{ props }` 必须整体展开到触发元素上；传了 `child` 时 `children` 不再生效。
child.en-US: Snippet that renders the trigger element itself. Its argument `{ props }` must be spread whole onto the trigger; when `child` is passed, `children` has no effect.

children.zh-CN: 触发元素的 snippet，会被包进 Tooltip 自己的 span，由该 span 接收触发属性。
children.en-US: Snippet for the trigger. It is wrapped in Tooltip's own span, which receives the trigger attributes.

class.en-US: Class name of the confirmation card.

clickToHide.zh-CN: 点击弹出层及其内部任一元素时是否关闭。
clickToHide.en-US: Whether a click on the popup or anything inside it closes it.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 弹出层打开期间按 Esc 是否关闭确认框；trigger 为 custom 时只调用 onEscKeyDown，由使用方决定是否关闭。
closeOnEsc.en-US: Whether Esc closes the open card. With trigger custom it only calls onEscKeyDown and the caller decides whether to close.

condition.zh-CN: 是否允许触发显示；仅显式设为 false 时，hover、click、focus 等触发行为不生效。由 true 变为 false 时立即关闭已显示的确认框；visible 受控时只调用 onVisibleChange(false)，使用方回写后才关闭。
condition.en-US: Whether it may be triggered. Only an explicit false disables the hover, click and focus triggers. Changing it from true to false closes an open card at once; with a controlled visible it only calls onVisibleChange(false), and the card closes once the caller writes back.

content.zh-CN: 确认框内容的 snippet，参数 `{ initialFocusRef }` 是回调，可直接写 `{@attach initialFocusRef}` 绑定到打开时需要聚焦的元素；不传时不渲染内容区。
content.en-US: Snippet for the content of the card. Its argument `{ initialFocusRef }` is a callback; write `{@attach initialFocusRef}` to bind it to the element that receives focus on open. Omitted, no content area is rendered.

contentClassName.en-US: Class name of the content container.

disableArrowKeyDown.zh-CN: 是否禁用在触发元素上按方向键把焦点移入确认框。
disableArrowKeyDown.en-US: Whether the arrow keys on the trigger are prevented from moving focus into the card.

disableFocusListener.zh-CN: trigger 为 hover 时，是否不响应键盘聚焦打开。
disableFocusListener.en-US: Whether keyboard focus is ignored when trigger is hover.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用；禁用时只渲染触发元素，不弹出确认框。
disabled.en-US: Whether it is disabled. A disabled Popconfirm renders only the trigger and never opens.

guardFocus.zh-CN: 焦点位于确认框内时，Tab 是否在其中循环。
guardFocus.en-US: Whether Tab cycles inside the card while focus is in it.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义图标的 snippet；不传时显示默认警告图标，传入 `null` 则不渲染图标。
icon.en-US: Snippet for a custom icon. The default warning icon shows when omitted; `null` renders no icon.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭时是否保留内容而不销毁。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the content stays mounted while closed.

mouseEnterDelay.zh-CN: 指针移入后延迟显示的毫秒数，仅 trigger 为 hover 或 focus 时生效。
mouseEnterDelay.en-US: Milliseconds before the card shows after the pointer enters. Applies to the hover and focus triggers.

mouseLeaveDelay.zh-CN: 指针移出后延迟隐藏的毫秒数，仅 trigger 为 hover 或 focus 时生效。
mouseLeaveDelay.en-US: Milliseconds before the card hides after the pointer leaves. Applies to the hover and focus triggers.

okButtonProps.zh-CN: 确认按钮的属性，autoFocus 为 true 时打开后聚焦该按钮，onclick 先于内置的确认处理执行。
okButtonProps.en-US: Props of the confirm button. autoFocus focuses it on open; onclick runs before the built-in confirm handling.

okText.zh-CN: 确认按钮文字，缺省取语言包 Popconfirm.confirm（zh_CN 为「确定」）。
okText.en-US: Confirm button text. Defaults to the locale entry Popconfirm.confirm.

onCancel.zh-CN: 点击取消按钮或关闭按钮的回调，参数是按钮的原生 click 事件；返回 Promise 时按钮保持加载，落定后才关闭，reject 时保留确认框。
onCancel.en-US: Called when the cancel or close button is clicked, with the button's native click event. A returned Promise keeps the button loading and closes the card once it resolves; a rejection keeps it open.

onClickOutSide.zh-CN: 确认框打开时在触发元素与确认框以外的区域按下鼠标时调用，仅 trigger 为 click、contextMenu 或 custom 时有效。
onClickOutSide.en-US: Called when the mouse is pressed outside of the trigger and the open card. Only for trigger click, contextMenu or custom.

onConfirm.zh-CN: 点击确认按钮的回调，参数是按钮的原生 click 事件；返回 Promise 时按钮保持加载，落定后才关闭，reject 时保留确认框。
onConfirm.en-US: Called when the confirm button is clicked, with the button's native click event. A returned Promise keeps the button loading and closes the card once it resolves; a rejection keeps it open.

onEscKeyDown.zh-CN: closeOnEsc 为 true 时，确认框打开期间按 Esc 调用。
onEscKeyDown.en-US: Called when Esc is pressed while the card is open and closeOnEsc is true.

onOpen.zh-CN: 确认框显示、进场动画开始时调用，每次打开一次，早于 afterOpen，受控与非受控相同；悬停打开后指针已离开而撤回的打开不调用。
onOpen.en-US: Called once per opening when the card is shown, as its enter animation starts, before afterOpen, controlled or not; not called for a hover open withdrawn because the pointer already left.

onVisibleChange.zh-CN: 显示状态变化时调用；visible 受控时只报告用户交互发起的请求，使用方自己改变 visible 不调用。
onVisibleChange.en-US: Called when the visibility changes; with a controlled visible it reports only requests from user interaction, not changes the caller makes to visible.

position.zh-CN: 弹出层相对触发元素的位置，共十二个方向。
position.en-US: Position of the popup relative to the trigger element, in twelve directions.

prefixCls.en-US: Class prefix of the confirmation card.

returnFocusOnClose.zh-CN: 关闭后焦点是否回到触发元素；受控的 visible 也照常生效，trigger 为 custom 时不生效。
returnFocusOnClose.en-US: Whether focus returns to the trigger after closing. It also works with a controlled visible, and has no effect with trigger custom.

role.zh-CN: 弹出层的 ARIA role，缺省为 dialog。
role.en-US: ARIA role of the popup. Defaults to dialog.

showCloseIcon.zh-CN: 是否显示右上角关闭按钮。
showCloseIcon.en-US: Whether the close button in the corner is shown.

spacing.zh-CN: 弹出层与触发元素的距离，单位为像素；对象形式分别设置水平与垂直方向。
spacing.en-US: Distance in pixels between the popup and the trigger. An object sets the horizontal and vertical distances.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的 click、mousedown 与焦点进出事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click, mousedown and focus in/out events on the popup stop propagating.

style.zh-CN: 确认卡片的样式字符串。
style.en-US: Style string of the confirmation card.

title.zh-CN: 标题，可以是字符串或 snippet，同时作为对话框的可访问名称。
title.en-US: Title, a string or a snippet, which also names the dialog.

trigger.zh-CN: 触发展示的时机，可选 hover、focus、click、contextMenu 或 custom。custom 时显示与否完全由 visible 决定。
trigger.en-US: When the card shows: hover, focus, click, contextMenu or custom. With custom, visible alone decides.

visible.zh-CN: 是否展示，可用 `bind:visible` 双向绑定；传入后由该值决定显示，trigger 保持原值，触发器事件仍然生效。
visible.en-US: Whether it is shown; bind it with `bind:visible`. When given, this value decides; trigger keeps its value and the trigger events still work.

focusTrigger.zh-CN: 让触发元素获得焦点，仅在 returnFocusOnClose 为 true 且 trigger 不是 custom 时生效；disabled 时调用无效果。
focusTrigger.en-US: Focuses the trigger. Only works when returnFocusOnClose is true and trigger is not custom; does nothing when disabled.
